depends_on: nim multiplication and the nim fields F_k = [0, 2^(2^k)) (Conway ONAG ch. 6); not in pinned Mathlib
notes: (1) product of nonzero nimbers below 2^n is 1: P(F_k + W x_k) = P(W) since prod_a (a + b x_k) = b (x_k^q + x_k = 1). (2) a(3*2^(n-1)-1) = y(n) = prod_{c<2^(n-1)} (2^n + c); y(n) = y(n - 2^k), and y(2^k) = y(2^(k-1)) because x_k^(2^m) + x_k = x_(k-1) + e2 with e2 in F2 (half-trace computation, Tr(alpha_(k-1)) = 1). Outside Lean: everything (nim-field structure is standard); numeric checks to n = 20/21.

prior_art.note: Case n = 2^k of (1) is Wilson's theorem; general cases not found.
